channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Channel Lane
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Rock Channel Lane (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Mission Rock Channel Lane: Added a record for Channel Lane.
item.description: Added a record for Channel Lane. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Channel Lane: The map notes said Channel Lane has a protected view corridor and that it is not yet built, with surface parking there today. The Design Controls call the view corridor a guideline ('should be maintained'), not a protected standard, and a 2018 plan cannot show today's condition. The notes now say that and cite the Port's June 2026 report; the lane's built state is not confirmed. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone and its change entry now cite the Sept 2019 Port memo that states the date.

item.title: Planned · Mission Rock Channel Lane: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls, which name this planned open space as Channel Lane (Design Controls Section 3.4); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sept 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05) (Jan 30, 2018)

Source: Port Commission Item 11A staff report, Jan 26 2018 (request); Port Commission Item 7A memo, Sept 20 2019 (approval date).
